captured_post.body:
🚨 **Warning: Super Long Informative Post Ahead. Lazy People Turn Back Now. No TL;DR here.** 🚨

I've seen a LOT of people show their DD's here. Some of y'all are REALLY good. *Some of y'all are REALLY bad.* I started my journey here on AfterHour as a DD machine. Literally. I created an AI DD bot to help with all of the requests. That was a LOT of fun (I'll spin it up again eventually). While I tend to leverage AI in almost every aspect of my life, I don't expect you all to follow that path (still working on @TerrifiedOfAI). As such, I want to show you how I do a manual DD on a company that I really want to invest in long term. For the purpose of this run through, I'll use $GLXY as an example. I've been speaking with @mphinance a bit on it and it's about time I do my own research. 

Here is an overview of the main sections in this **LONG post** that I cover in my own research: 

1️⃣ Company Fundamentals 
2️⃣ Recent News Developments
3️⃣ Growth Drivers
4️⃣ Risks and Challenges 
5️⃣ Industry/Competition Comparisons
6️⃣ Sentiment 
7️⃣ Chart Review 
8️⃣ Sector and Macro Knowledge 
9️⃣ Valuation and Investment Thesis
🔟 Action Plan and Risk Management 

All info is from the last 6 months to keep it relevant. I'll link sources inline where I can. A lot of this information will overlap, but I'll try to limit regurgitating the same facts and go into more detail in sections where it's more relevant. 

Before we even begin diving into the DD, let's do a very quick overview of the company we'll be investigating:

Galaxy Digital Holdings Ltd. ($GLXY) is a beast in crypto and AI infra. If you're long-term bullish on digital assets and compute power, this could be your jam.

# 1️⃣ Company Fundamentals 
*Start with the basics: What does the company do, who's running it, and how's the money situation looking?*

🌌 **What does Galaxy do?** 🌌

Galaxy is a diversified financial services firm focused on digital assets and blockchain. Their business breaks down into a few key segments: 

Digital Assets (trading, lending, derivatives)

Asset Management (managing billions in AUM, including ETFs and staking)

Investment Banking (M&A advisory, capital markets)

Infrastructure Solutions (custody, tokenization via GK8, staking). 

🤴 **Who's In Charge?** 🤴

CEO: Mike Novogratz
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/novogratz

After graduating from Princeton in Economics, Mike partnered with Goldman Sachs for 11 years before becoming a CIO at Fortress Investment Group for 13 years. A few years after in 2017, he founded Galaxy Digital. He's a Wall Street vet with a track record in macro trading and crypto evangelism. His leadership has grown AUM to over $5B historically, and he's steering the ship toward institutional adoption.

CIO: Christopher Ferarro
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/christopher-ferraro-23983165

Prior to joining the firm, he was a Managing Director and Partner at HPS Investments Partners (f.k.a. Highbridge Principal Strategies), where he worked within the Direct Lending & Special Situations Group. Here, he focused on originating, structuring, underwriting and executing on private debt and equity transactions in middle- and large-sized corporations operating primarily in North America and Western Europe. Previously, he began his career at BlackRock Kelso Capital Advisors, an investment manager for a publicly-traded business development company focused on structuring and executing on middlemarket structured debt and equity investments. He holds a B.A. in Applied Mathematics and a B.A. in Economics from Yale University.

🏦 **Company Finances** 🏦

Reference Source: https://investor.galaxy.com/financials/quarterly-results/default.aspx

Financially, as of Q2 2025 (ended June 30), they reported net income of $30.7M ($0.08 EPS), up from prior quarters, with adjusted EBITDA hitting $211M driven by digital asset appreciation and investments.

Revenue TTM is ~$2.34B USD, but net income TTM is -73.65M due to volatility, which is classic crypto exposure. Balance sheet is rock-solid: ~$9B in combined AUM and assets under stake (up 27% QoQ), cash/stablecoins ~$1.2B, debt-to-equity at 149.33% (manageable for growth mode).

They hold significant BTC/ETH (e.g., 17,102 BTC as of Q2 2025). Governance is strong, with a focus on compliance. Overall, fundamentals tell me they are a "growth engine" if crypto/AI tailwinds help carry momentum, which is likely with the current administration's stance on crypto.

# 2️⃣ Recent News Developments
*News is your pulse check on the company. Look at news in the past 6 months to make sure it's all relevant.*

**Q2 Results - August 5th**
Net income of $30.7M, adjusted gross profit growth in Digital Assets; adjusted EBITDA strong but operating results remain quarter-sensitive. $299M adjusted gross profit, $211M EBITDA, with Digital Assets up 10% QoQ to $71.4M gross profit. They executed massive trades, like selling ~80K BTC for a client (> $9B notional). Company reported $1.2B cash & stablecoins as part of its balance disclosure.

*Source:* https://investor.galaxy.com/financials/quarterly-results/default.aspx

**Partnerships**
Galaxy is developing the Helios data-center campus (in West Texas) and has a partnership/commitment from CoreWeave, a strategic revenue pipeline for infrastructure income. Analysts have flagged this as a multi-year growth opportunity. 

*Source:* https://www.barrons.com/articles/galaxy-digital-earnings-crypto-stock-price-365700aa

**Transition to U.S. GAAP and Nasdaq listing**
Galaxy completed re-domestication and Nasdaq listing this year, improving US investor visibility and reporting comparability.

*Source:* https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859392/000185939225000007/glxy-20250331xpressrelease.htm

**Other Notable Wins**
Oversubscribed $175M crypto venture fund, partnerships in tokenization (e.g., tokenizing $GLXY on Solana), and treasury deals with firms like Ford ($FORD), $BMNR and $SBET for custody/staking. 

*Source:* https://investor.galaxy.com/news/default.aspx.

Regulatory nod: Settled with NY AG on March 27 for compliance.

*Source:* https://ag.ny.gov/sites/default/files/settlements-agreements/galaxy-digital-holding-ltd-et-al-assurance-of-discontinuance-2025.pdf

# 3️⃣ Growth Drivers 
*What's going push this company forward?*

🪙 **Crypto Adoption** 🪙

They're crushing treasury services (15+ deals like $FORD, $BMNR), generating IB fees, execution, staking, and custody revenue, potentially hundreds of millions.

GalaxyOne (retail "everything app" for crypto/finance) could rival $HOOD/$COIN. GalaxyOne Institutional offers all the tools institutions need to trade, finance, store, and manage digital assets efficiently.

Tokenization via GK8 and AllUnity JV (33% owned, MiCA-compliant EURO stablecoin) positions them for RWA boom.

*Sources:* 
https://investor.galaxy.com/news/news-details/2025/Galaxy-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2024-Financial-Results/default.aspx

https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/galaxy-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial-results-302521785.html

https://www.galaxy.com/one

🏗️ **Infrastructure and Data Centers** 🏗️

Galaxy is developing the Helios data-center campus (in West Texas). Helios has 800MW of approved power and a 600MW contract signed with CoreWeave $CRWV that will provide $900M a year in average annual revenue, almost all the costs flow through to $CRWV giving Galaxy EXTREMELY attractive economics (better than basically any other Hyperscaler deal out there) with management estimating 90% EBITDA margins. The reason they got such an attractive deal is because unlike other Bitcoin miners Galaxy has a massive balance sheet that they can use to finance the buildout of Helios.

*Source:* https://www.barrons.com/articles/galaxy-digital-earnings-crypto-stock-price-365700aa

# 4️⃣ Risks and Challenges 
*There isn't a single company out there that doesn't face risks and road bumps. You have to consider the downside factors as a possibility.*

🪙 **Crypto Volatility and Regulation** 🪙

It's no surprise that the stock price moves with BTC/ETH. Why? Their balance sheet does too. Market cycles and seasonal volumes can cause their QoQ net income to flip sign rapidly. A prolonged bear market could also be devastating for them.

On top of the wild swings, the company must stay ahead of lawmakers and their policies. Crypto regulation developments can affect trading volume, valuation models and even their product offerings.

*Source:* https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859392/000185939225000007/glxy-20250331xpressrelease.htm

🚧 **Infrastructure Execution Risks** 🚧

The  Data-Center and Helios build out requires a lot of captial and precision with operation execution. Additionally, they are still pending some approvals from ERCOT, which is notorious for being slow to move on anything outside of SpaceX... I wish that was a joke.

Galaxy will also need ~$5-6B to complete this buildout which they plan to finance via 20% equity and 80% debt. They have the equity component secured, and are in the final stages of securing financing. They were able to grab $1.5B in August, but that hasn't filled the gap completely.

*Source:* https://www.barrons.com/articles/galaxy-digital-earnings-crypto-stock-price-365700aa

👨‍💻 **Cybersecurity Concerns** 👨‍💻

This one hits home for me as I own an MDR cybersecurity company. On September 15th, 2025 Galaxy issued a statement regarding an incident that occurred. A node package manager (NPM) account was was compromised for a prominent JavaScript developer through a Phishing attack. While Galaxy maintains it wasn't affected, these news breaks are often major deterrents for new investors. 

*Source:* https://www.galaxy.com/insights/research/npm-breach-lessons-for-crypto-users

# 5️⃣ Industry/Competition Comparisons
*You have to make sure that they are ahead of or level with the competition. You don't want to pick the industry loser.*

🪙 **Coinbase - $COIN** 🪙

Coinbase has a larger retail franchise with a revenue stream focused on fees and volume. They also have a larger market cap. 

Galaxy has more volatility, a more diverse business mix (full service industry platform and balance sheet exposure vs. Coinbase's exchange).

*Source:* https://portfolioslab.com/tools/stock-comparison/GLXY.TO/COIN

⛏️ **Marathon - $MARA** ⛏️

Galaxy is more diversified than mining-focused Marathon, but this allows $MARA to take the win for more $BTC stacked up. Marathon is 2nd in the rankings ($MSTR being first, obviously), while Galaxy takes the 9th seat in the top 10 publicly traded companies with the most Bitcoin.

*Source:* https://www.coingecko.com/en/treasuries/bitcoin

🏦 **Other crypto-finance / investment firms (e.g., Bitwise, Grayscale)** 🏦

There is obviously overlap in asset-management competition. This will never go away.

Galaxy is differentiated by its combination of balance-sheet exposure, trading principal activity, and infrastructure plays (data centers). Most of the competition is heavily focused on a single area. 


# 6️⃣ Sentiment
*Analysts and Retail sentiment often dictates how much attention a stock gets in a certain timeframe. A huge shift in sentiment could cause a drop in confidence, or vice versa.*

🕵️‍♂️ **Analysts** 🕵️‍♂️

Consensus strong buy with an average target of $36.67 across 6 analysts with a top target of $40 by Benchmark this last August. 

*Source:* https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/GLXY/ratings/ 

🤔 **Retail Sentiment** 🤔

On X, several major influencers are posting bullish comments, with longs calling it "generational." A lot of keywords thrown in these posts that are notable: "deep value," "AI/Crypto Combo," "$100+ upside target."

*Sources:*
On X:
@WalksWallstreet  / @ncbtrades / @solspacecadet / @Barry3252181 / @NicolasFlamelX

On AH:
@mphinance

*You can't live in a bubble and just focus on the company alone. The world around the company you are researching can have a major affect on price action and operations.*

🪙 **Crypto Sector** 🪙

Bull Market continues with HH/HL stair stepping. Major ETF approvals, Tokenization assets, stablecoins growth, regulations improving and AI/Crypto intersection continues to fuel the crypto pump.

# 9️⃣ Valuation and Investment Thesis
*Now its time to look at the worth of the company and create a thesis.*

💰 **Valuation** 💰

*Market Cap:* $12.52B
*Forward P/E:* 204 (Due to High Growth)
*Debt to Assets:* 71.1%
*Gross Profit:* $316M
*Profit Margin:* 3.48%
*Net Cash Flow:* $229M

*Ownership:*
40.8% = Institutional
13.3% = Institutional Fund
0.5% = Fund Ownership
2.6% = Insider Ownership
42.9% = Other

*Source:* 
Https://digital.fidelity.com/prgw/digital/research/quote/dashboard/key-statistics?symbol=GLXY


 🤔 **Investment Thesis** 🤔

$GLXY is an undervalued infra bet on crypto and AI convergence. It has a diversified revenue stream, strong industry-proven leadership, and a slew of catalysts still coming through (ERCOT approvals, treasury ramp ups).

Long Term Hold: $100 in 1-2 years via Helios cash flows, continued tokenization, GalaxyOne. ~60% upside potential if held. 

*Source:* @DoubleDownToWin (me), its an opinion. 


# 🔟 Action Plan and Risk Management
*The research is done and we have our thesis. If we like the company, sentiment and chart, its time to plan when to buy and when to sell.*

📑 **Action Plan** 📑
- *Entry:* Current levels, or a slight pullback to $29-30. Or scale in on catalysts.
- *Allocation:* High Risk - max 5-10% of portfolio
- *Hold Period:* Long-Term Hold (1-5 Years)
- *What to Watch:* Quarterly Earnings (they tend to dip), crypto prices, Helios milestones, and regulatory updates.

⚠️ **Risk Management** ⚠️
*ALWAYS have an exit strategy, for the good and bad.*

- *Stop-Loss:* Set at 15-20% below entry. 
- *Considerations:* Crypto is volatile, so a tight SL is bound to get hit if you aren't paying attention. Diversify and rebalance if crypto crashes. Exit if fundamentals shift (delayed approvals from ERCOT, net loss spikes, etc). 
- *Take Profit:* $75-100 if holding long term.

# 👨‍🎓 We Did It! We Graduated from "How to DD" 

Thanks for sticking through the long post and research. While many investors will have different research styles and data they hone in on, the purpose of this was to show you the highlights of important points to pay close attention to as you work through your own due diligence. Remember that Sections 9 and 10 are up to your own thoughts and predictions. Use the information you gathered to form YOUR OWN CONVICTION.

Speaking of conviction... What are some of yours? What do you think of $GLXY? Is it the hidden crypto/AI gem that @mphinance believes it is? Drop your takes below.

Also, let me know what you think I missed (I'm sure there is a LOT), what I should add to my own DD research, or if you have any questions. I love to chat!
